title: Samsung 9kg Smart Front Load Washer $743 ($676 via Price Check Button) + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ The Good Guys
body:
Deal: Samsung 9kg Smart Front Load Washer $743 ($676 via Price Check Button) + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ The Good Guys

[Ash-Say] Appliances Onlie is better for delivery as $686 includes free delivery
https://www.appliancesonline.com.au/product/samsung-9kg-smar…
[jazzza] You can ask good guys to match appliances online including delivery and pickup old washer. Last week that did this for me. I had giftcards which I couldn't use with appliances online
[PinzVidz] Not bad. Currently $749.25 on EPP (or $699.25 with trade -in). Was $649.35 ($599.35 trade-in) on EPP a couple of weeks back.
[jimojr] I wouldn't recommend this Samsung washer based on my experience.
From day one, it has been much louder than expected during the spin cycle, with excessive vibration that makes it feel like the drum isn't properly balanced. It's possible I just received a faulty unit, but what really disappointed me was Samsung's after-sales service.
The technician only ran a quick 10-minute empty wash, said nothing was wrong, and left without properly investigating the issue. I was simply told to contact Samsung again if it continued.
Another disappointment is the capacity. Although it's rated at 11kg, it doesn't feel any larger than my old 8.5kg top loader.
The washer cleans well and the SmartThings notifications are useful, but the poor support has put me off buying another Samsung washing machine.
[Puglife] He would recommend a different washing machine
[Fistov Stone] I wouldn't recommend Samsung washing machines either. I paid $950 for a 9kg one to last me only 5 years before bearing failure. Never again. Additionally easy choices take eternity. I've bought a Haier and already prefer it, direct drive, self dosage and less expensive.
[jimojr] We had an LG 7kg washer that lasted more than 10 years. As the kids grew up, we upgraded to a Samsung 8.5kg top loader, but it only lasted about 5 years before it started shaking badly during the spin cycle. That's why we bought this Samsung 11kg front loader.
We also had the door replaced on the old LG, and LG's customer service was excellent. They came out promptly after I contacted them.
Samsung was the opposite. I first lodged a claim through The Good Guys, then about a week later Samsung contacted me and made me submit everything again, including the invoice, photos and videos. They also told me that if the technician couldn't find a fault, I'd have to pay the call out fee, which wasn't very reassuring. After that, I had to wait another week for a technician, who only did a quick check and said nothing was wrong.
[Brick50] I could see the backlight shining through the back of my Samsung TV, had to help the repair man handle the TV and lay it on my carpet etc which was fine.. His solution was some bluetack on the back to hide the warped plastic housing/block out the light
[Fistov Stone] I just reread my earlier comment and realised predictive text failed me.

Not recommanded as the same issue above, loud spin, the installation man without tighten up the bolt at the bottom. Even tighten up the machine moved with fast spinning of the drum. So dispointed at its quality.
[swiggity123] I have the oler gen model and this washing machine works fine. It only had one issue where it would have a loud vibration and samsung got a technician the next day and they said it was just not levelled properly so they fixed it for me. no issues, works great. i bought mine for $570 delivered through EPP pricing about 2.5 years ago.
I guess we will wait and see but i regularly clean the filter and drum and maintain as much as i can.
